title: Companies House accessibility statements
text:
Each Companies House service has its own accessibility statement, with details of:

 • how accessible the service is

 • how to report problems

 • when the statement was prepared

 • when the service was last tested
changeNote: Added an English and Welsh language accessibility statement for the Companies House Webchat service.
